configuration.prompt: Explain why an inference engine uses a paged KV cache.

strict_b1_forward.timing_scope: Prebuilt PrefillBatch forwards only: B1/all query logits, B1/last query logits, or one packed batch/last rows. Includes forward validation, selected-row index validation/device index-tensor creation, output copies and completion synchronization. Excludes model load, tokenization, batch metadata construction, host selection planning, correctness checks, warmup, fingerprint/GPU snapshots and cleanup. CUDA Events measure the dispatch timeline including launch gaps, not pure kernel instructions. No decode, scheduler, sampling, generation TPS or HTTP latency is measured.
strict_b1_forward.memory_scope: Allocated peaks include the loaded model, preallocated KV pool and output buffers. Additional allocated peak is relative to pre-forward allocation. Reserved peaks include allocator caching from setup, correctness and previous modes; they are not isolated process-memory footprints.
limitations: Cold prefill only; every query starts at position zero.
All modes use the same new prefill attention path; sequential_full is a prebuilt B1 baseline, not an exact legacy implementation.
GPU snapshots cannot establish exclusive hardware use, especially under Windows WDDM.

numerical_diagnostic.interpretation: Consistent with shape-dependent low-precision roundoff; not a proof of batch invariance. Strict per-element KV threshold remains failed. No tolerances were relaxed.

conclusions: Selective LMhead reduced additional peak allocation (512 tokens: 150.63 to 21.13 MiB); no consistent latency improvement in this pilot.
Multi-request timings are exploratory: KV validation explicitly skipped after the strict failure; no accepted ratio.
Prefill forward measurements exclude metadata preparation, scheduler, generation and HTTP. No cross-engine ranking.
Dense auto/math/flash/dandan attention remains per request; only CUDA backend directly reads paged ragged history.
Compute-sanitizer, broader quality/long-sequence validation and controlled end-to-end measurements remain pending.
